limitations: Each game advances exactly 600,000 model milliseconds at 300 ms per accepted action by default. Execution is accelerated; this is not evidence of ten minutes of real foreground browser play.
Rotations within each seed are correlated; independent seed count is reported separately.
Winner and profile frequencies describe this sample and do not establish balance or causal profile strength.
Node timings omit canvas rendering, input latency, scheduling, background throttling and mobile costs.
Captures count ownership transfers; removals include attacks and supply retreats. Event totals depend on public engine event classification.
